trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It unlocks the moment the other 54 are earned, so it can never be left behind on its own.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is the reward for the whole list, not a task by itself. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, collectibles, activities, and the 100% checklist last. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it unlocks in the first minutes of the story and cannot be missed. Just play the introduction through to its end. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. No side work is needed — keep following the story markers. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full, mission by mission, until the chapter closes. Like every chapter trophy, it is story progress only and cannot be missed. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full. Keep following the story markers; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in full. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale — finish the chapter, then take on the final mission. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from the final mission, the last story beat; free roam opens right after, so nothing after it can be missed either.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the last story beat before the open-world cleanup — finish it, then turn to the 100% checklist. Note: story missions cannot be replayed, so keep manual saves before big missions. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; replay note via GTAViceCityHub trophy guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the story — play the mission when its marker appears and finish it. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so it comes to you as the plot advances — finish the heist and the trophy pops. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission like the rest of this set — play it when it appears and see it through to the end. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It arrives with the story, so there is nothing to hunt for — take the mission marker and finish the job. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Follow the story to the mission and finish it; the airport setting is the clue to where it plays out. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It pops from story progress itself: finish the mission or chapter and it unlocks. There is no mission replay, but nothing here can be skipped past because the story only moves forward through these beats.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — take it when the plot offers it and play it to the end. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The 100% checklist stays open in free roam after the story and everything on it can still be done; it is long, not locked out.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist (35 tasks, per KeenGamer's roadmap). This is the longest trophy in the list — treat it as the final gold and clear everything else first, then mop up whatever the checklist still shows. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; 100% checklist via KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses and stunt-driving moments all count toward the total. Spread it across the whole playthrough instead of grinding it at the end; any vehicle works, so let the count build as you drive. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — sample everything (races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, meditation and more) rather than mastering one. Open the activities list and tick each type off once. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The range's challenges can be replayed as often as needed until every one is gold; there is no one-shot attempt.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (challenge count per the competition kit's official list). Work through the range's weapon drills one at a time and replay any that fall short of gold until each one clears it. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; 42 challenges per the kit's official list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location. Learn each course's line first, then race for the win — every location must be won, not just visited. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Enter a new race type or location after each win and keep a note of which you have already won. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge when Cal offers it and reel steadily rather than rushing — a lost fish can be tried again. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Any arcade cabinet counts and any full game counts; replay it until it clicks.
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick the cabinet you find easiest and finish one full game. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Contact strands stay available through the story and into free roam; finish the strand's last mission whenever it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish that contact's mission strand — the strand's last mission pops the trophy. Check the map for Andy's marker after each story chapter. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Contact strands stay available through the story and into free roam; finish the strand's last mission whenever it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand to its end; the final mission in the strand is the one that counts. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Contact strands stay available through the story and into free roam; finish the strand's last mission whenever it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand — the trophy pops on the strand's last mission, not on the earlier ones. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Stranger strands stay on the map through the story and into free roam; eight finished strands earns it, in any order.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Take every stranger mission you meet and finish each strand; eight completed strands earns it, so keep accepting them as they appear on the map. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Contact strands stay available through the story and into free roam; finish the strand's last mission whenever it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its final mission — the trophy is for the strand's ending, so earlier missions alone do not count. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Contact strands stay available through the story and into free roam; finish the strand's last mission whenever it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand; the last mission in it pops the trophy. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableDetail: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only one in the list. Exactly when: one meditation spot, at Jason's house, is reported to be available in Chapter 1 only, and it stops being usable once Chapter 1 ends. How to avoid it: meditate at Jason's house before you finish Chapter 1 — do it the first time you are free in the open world. Keep a manual save from before the end of Chapter 1 until the trophy pops, so you can go back if you forget. The other 17 spots stay available later, so only this one spot can lock the trophy out. Source: PowerPyx (1 possibly missable) and KeenGamer's roadmap.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total (count per KeenGamer). POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one spot, at Jason's house, is reported to be available in Chapter 1 only — meditate there before the chapter ends, and keep manual saves, since story missions cannot be replayed. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; 18 spots and missable warning via KeenGamer; GTABase / PowerPyx flag this as the only possibly missable trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Bret's strand and its hunt stay available through the story and into free roam; the target is a single named animal, not a one-time spawn.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he asks for the hunt, then track the animal he names — it is a single named target, not open hunting. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards across Leonida and finish any three full sets — duplicates do not complete a set, so keep trading or hunting the cards you still lack. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 locations. Treat it as a sightseeing checklist: open WAiNK at landmarks, towns and viewpoints until the counter hits 100. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work the in-game challenge list across activities — the count is cumulative, so small challenges from many activities add up to 50. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road, build the wanted level, then break line of sight and hide until it clears — do it with your partner in the vehicle. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run while keeping the heat — plan a route with three close shops and keep your partner with you the whole way. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter 100 distinct vehicle models. Borrow anything new you see; the counter tracks discovery, not ownership, so you never need to buy them. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five, trigger Combat Focus, and clear them before it ends — a crowded fight is the right moment. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The airport stays open in free roam; leave it in an unplanned way whenever you like and retry if it does not pop.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Leave the airport grounds in an unplanned way — on foot or in a vehicle — rather than through a normal exit. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it — the description's joke is the hint. Military hardware is found at guarded sites, so expect a fight to take one, then enjoy the ride. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, nobody spotting you — and leave clean; if you are seen, leave and retry the job. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan five vault jobs and get clear after each one; the count is cumulative across the game, so the jobs do not need to happen in one run. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take its cargo, then lose any wanted level that follows. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The whole map stays open in free roam after the story; any region not yet visited can be driven to at any time.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map. Drive through each area until the map is fully revealed; check the map for greyed-out corners and visit them. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one operation per gang across the state — work through the gangs one at a time until every gang's operation is robbed. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Ocean Beach bars stay open in free roam; order the cocktail whenever you are passing.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy, not a mission. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through the showroom and out the frontage — the classic GTA way in and out. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The bowling alley stays open in free roam; bowl a full game there at any time.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a full game at that alley — the follow-through in the description is the hint that a complete game counts. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable as far as the list shows, but its exact trigger is unconfirmed before launch. Build the partnership by playing missions and activities together and check the tracker after launch.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — build your partnership's standing by doing missions and activities together with your partner. It unlocks as the partnership grows; the exact trigger is unconfirmed before launch, so check the in-game tracker as you play. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; trigger unconfirmed per KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable, but watch out: it pops for a story choice, and story missions cannot be replayed. Keep a manual save before big story decisions so you can reload and take the other path if the choice you made does not pop it.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — this pops for a story choice. There is no way to force it early: play the story and make the choices when they come, and keep manual saves before big decisions in case you want the other outcome. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is for succeeding on a second try, so failing once is part of how it is earned; retry freely.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try. Fail an attempt once, then succeed on the retry; the trophy is for the comeback, not the first try. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableDetail: Not confirmed missable. Its unlock is unconfirmed before launch and it likely ties to a strange open-world encounter; keep an eye on odd events and check the tracker after launch.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a hidden trophy whose unlock is unconfirmed before launch; it likely ties to a strange encounter in the open world. Keep an eye on odd events and check the tracker after launch. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; method unconfirmed per KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. It is retryable in free roam after the story: if an attempt fails, leave and try again. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing locks it out.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — strike targets down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed — try a drive-by melee near the bowling alley. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles; method unconfirmed per KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Progress is cumulative and builds up over a normal playthrough; free roam after the story gives unlimited time to finish it.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills to your contacts over time until the total hits $250,000 — it is cumulative, so small amounts add up. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Progress is cumulative and builds up over a normal playthrough; free roam after the story gives unlimited time to finish it.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy gear, clothes, food and vehicles across Leonida's shops; spending is cumulative, so it builds up over a normal playthrough. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. Garages stay on the market in free roam after the story; buy them whenever you have the money.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market — check the property listings across the map and work through them one by one. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableDetail: Not missable. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough and keeps counting in free roam after the story, so it can always be finished later.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or register ten different vehicles you find through the app — any ten distinct vehicles count. Source: official trophy list via Exophase / PSNProfiles.
